caption: The drawing depicts a single oval-shaped basin with sloping sides, rendered in grayscale. The exterior surface of the basin is dark and decorated with a horizontal, curving band featuring a pattern of elongated, oval-shaped leaves and stems, which encircle the upper half of the basin. On either end, inside the basin, there are larger, fan-like leaf motifs that extend down from the top edge. The interior bottom of the basin is lighter in color and decorated with a symmetrical, circular floral pattern with curved lines, leaves, and small dots forming a central design. The overall surface of the basin appears slightly worn, with some visible scratches and marks. The background is plain and lightly shaded, with no additional objects or details.
title: Bread Tray
